observations: Photo 0 shows a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO multifunction laser printer/copier with a large paper output area and a control panel on the right.
The front lower label on the machine body appears to read 'bizhub PRO C754e'.
The screen/control area is not clearly readable for status, and there is no close-up of model/serial plate.
No photo shows print samples, toner condition, error messages, or internal paper path.

claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO colour MFP body (bizhub PRO series) and the front label reads 'bizhub PRO C754e'.
Photo 0 front label appears to read 'bizhub PRO C754e', not C854e.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller text says C854e but photo label appears C754e). Wrong model affects parts, serviceability, and value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate (usually on the side/back) showing the exact model number and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat it as not confirmed to be the claimed model (use the lower end of similar Konica Minolta MFPs).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no power-on, no error display, no print/copy sample).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on + copy/print a test page, showing no error codes and a clean output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs service (worst-case for remote buying).

risks.risk: Colour capability/toner readiness not verifiable (no toner cartridges/toner levels shown).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of all toner cartridges and toner level indicators (or a video showing the machine reporting toner status).
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/low toner risk (worst-case: assume you may need to replace toners).

risks.risk: Paper handling issues (rollers, fuser, paper jams) not visible from one exterior shot.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing feeding from the tray and successful duplex/normal output (if supported) for multiple pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential paper path/fuser service needed (worst-case).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate showing the exact model number (C754e vs C854e) and serial.
Short power-on + test print/copy video with the screen visible and no error codes.
Photos of toner cartridges and toner level/status indicators.
Video showing paper feeding and output for at least 5–10 pages (preferably including colour output).
response.reason: The photo suggests the machine is a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e, while the seller text claims C854e, and there is no proof of working condition (no test print/copy). Without the decisive model confirmation and functionality proof, a safe price cannot be set.
